name: 棋祈督（黑子）
evolution: 棋棋（黑子） Lv.26 → 棋祈督（黑子） → 棋契陛下
description: “曾经有洛克试图用黑子的外壳打造行军的铠甲，却在淬火瞬间听见棋子内部传来低沉的声音，黑暗中工匠们的影子被炉火吞噬，所有想要拆解棋子的工匠都遭遇了不幸。”——《黄金时代的地系工匠们·十六》
descriptionEn: Once a Rocco tried to use the black piece's shell to forge marching armor, but at the quenching moment heard a low voice from inside the piece; in the darkness the craftsmen's shadows were swallowed by the furnace fire, and all craftsmen who tried to dismantle the pieces met misfortune. — 'The Earth Craftsmen of the Golden Age · XVI'
